title: [Chapitre] VIII. Analysis situs (quatrième mouture) : notes manuscrites (26/06-04/07/1986).

errors: Condition (i) is written '|X| ≤ |Y|'; inclusion ⊂ is meant.

Condition (iv) is partly redundant given the definitions. By induction it is equivalent to |∂X| = ∪_{Y<X}|Y|°, which needs well-foundedness of the order below X (e.g. finite X̃). This is not stated on this page but is presumably part of the m-gérie axioms.

(ii) only demands disjointness for the |∘| relation. Getting a genuine partition of |M| into open cells would need |∘| to hold for all non-comparable pairs. Not an error, but the precise meaning of |∘| is defined elsewhere.

ideas.what: Characterising maps from an abstract face/incidence poset to subsets of a set that come from morphisms into a structure of 'figures': closed cells, boundary as union of lower cells, open cells as complements, with axioms of monotonicity, disjoint interiors, nonempty interiors and closure = union of lower open cells.
ideas.modern_name: Cell decomposition / stratification indexed by a face poset (frontier condition, regular CW / regular cell complexes and their face posets; P-stratified spaces)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Classical: CW complexes (Whitehead 1949); face posets of regular cell complexes (Björner 1984); poset-stratified spaces (Thom/Mather, later Lurie, Higher Algebra Appendix A)
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984) calls for a 'topologie modérée' and dévissage of stratified structures, but not this combinatorial axiomatics.

ideas.what: Definitions |Φ| = ∪|X|, ∂X = X̃−{X}, |X|° = |X|∖|∂X| inside a purely set-theoretic 'analysis situs'.
ideas.modern_name: Boundary and open cell of a cell in a cellular stratification

missed.claim: This page belongs to the 1986 'Analysis situs' project: an axiomatic, combinatorial foundation of (tame) topology via 'm-géries' and 'figures'. That programme was never published or developed. This page itself carries only the standard realisation conditions of a cell poset, so nothing beyond the overall framework is new.
missed.quote: quelles sont les conditions sur une application X ↦ |X| : M → 𝔓(P), pour pouvoir être définie par un morphisme d'attaches?
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: Of mainly historical interest, as part of Grothendieck's attempt at a combinatorial 'topologie modérée'. It is comparable to modern work on face posets and exit-path / stratified combinatorics, but contains no specific new result.

deep.surprise_reason: The page states natural, essentially classical axioms for realising an abstract face poset as a set-theoretic cell decomposition. It is interesting only as a piece of the unpublished Analysis situs programme, with no unexpected result.
transcription_corrections: 'Fig il (𝒫)' should read 'Fig él(P)' (figures élémentaires), consistent with 'figure élémentaire' on the next page.
'par (α) paragraphe précédent' likely reads 'par (α) p. précédente' (page précédente).
'Il faut donc voir que les familles' is likely 'que la famille' (continued on p.60 as 'des |Y|, Y ∈ X̃').
'X |0| Y' should be 'X |∘| Y' (disjoint-interiors relation, as on p.60).
'(i) ... |X| ≤ |Y|': the handwriting shows ≤ but inclusion ⊂ is meant.
In (iv) the index under ∪ looks like 'Y ≤ X' (possibly 'Y ∈ X̃'); the ∪|Y|° is written on the line of (iii) but belongs to (iv).
